about.title: Corte Madera Product Liability Claims
about.longDescription: Corte Madera is a small, walkable Marin County town where residents shop, cook, garden, and commute between US-101 and local corridors like Tamalpais Drive and Paradise Drive using everyday consumer goods, tools, and vehicle parts. When one of those products fails — a car part that breaks, a kitchen appliance that overheats, a piece of equipment with a hidden design flaw — the injury can be sudden and serious. California law generally allows injured people to pursue a strict liability claim against manufacturers, distributors, or retailers without having to prove anyone was careless, only that the product was defective and that the defect caused harm. If a defective product has hurt you or a family member in Corte Madera, LawProactive can connect you, free of charge, with an independent attorney who reviews these cases and works on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless there's a recovery. Keeping the product itself, along with packaging and receipts, can matter a great deal to this process.

items.title: Strict Liability Can Simplify Your Case
items.desc: California generally allows injured people to hold manufacturers responsible by showing a product was defective, not that the company was careless. This can make it easier to pursue accountability after an injury.

items.title: Multiple Parties May Share Responsibility
items.desc: Manufacturers, distributors, and retailers can each potentially be liable for a defective product under California law. An independent attorney can help sort out who may owe compensation.

items.title: Free, No-Obligation Connection
items.desc: LawProactive doesn't charge for connecting you with an attorney, and the attorneys in our network work on contingency, so there's no fee unless your case results in a recovery.

items.question: What should I do with the product that hurt me?
items.answer: Try to preserve the product exactly as it was at the time of the injury, including any packaging, instructions, or remaining pieces if it broke apart. Don't attempt repairs or discard it, since the product itself is often central evidence in a defect claim. An attorney can advise on safe storage until it's evaluated.

items.question: Do I have to prove the manufacturer was negligent?
items.answer: Not necessarily. California product liability claims often proceed under strict liability, meaning you generally need to show the product was defective and that the defect caused your injury, rather than proving the company acted carelessly. This is different from many other types of injury claims.

items.question: Does it matter that Corte Madera is a small town for this type of claim?
items.answer: No — product liability claims aren't tied to local crash patterns like the ones near US-101 or Tamalpais Drive, since they involve the product itself rather than roadway conditions. Whether you're in Corte Madera or elsewhere in Marin County, the same California product liability principles generally apply.
